pictures.author: Joseolgon
pictures.observed: Current two-face upper view: pale square ashlar shaft, recessed small barred window/relieving arch, corbels under projecting balcony, muted glazed railing, high round-arched lookout glazing with paired slender columns/capitals, curved segmental pediments and steep square silver-grey lead spire/gold finial. Transient equipment omitted.

pictures.author: Gryffindor
pictures.observed: Wider Second Courtyard view shows the tall stone tower independent of the Council portico below, two levels of small shaft windows, projecting balcony/corbels, arched gridded lookout, curved pediments and narrow lead pyramid. The current balcony glazing follows the2026 photograph; precise height and hidden lower access remain approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Tower of Justice (Adalet Kulesi) only, fifth authored member of18 required Topkapi Palace structures. Square pale masonry shaft with real recessed barred windows, corbelled projecting balcony and muted glazed railing, taller four-sided belvedere with arched recessed glazing and eight paired corner shafts, segmental curved pediments, closed curved roof shoulders, steep square lead pyramid and small gold finial. Council Hall/attached portico, Harem and Outer Treasury remain independent. No invented clock, furnished stair/interior, exact sculptural carving, copied inscriptions, visitors or transient CCTV/maintenance equipment.
